Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tairakuri-soba/

You'll experience nearly the entire soba-making process—from preparing the dough to kneading, stretching, and cutting. Then you'll enjoy the soba noodles you made yourself for lunch, served with tempura made from local vegetables.

【Fee】
• Adults: ¥4,000
• Elementary school children: ¥3,000
• Preschool children: ¥1,500
(Includes guide, insurance, and lunch)

【Capacity】
2 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】
Taira Chestnut Farm (Tairakuri-en) staff

【What to bring】
Drink, apron, head scarf, towel, mask

【Notes】
Taira Chestnut Farm website: https://tairakurien.com/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: 🎉 Experience making soba noodles and savoring the countryside with all five senses — try your hand at making 28% soba!!
